title: unity / Editing Evolved
content:
## Editing Evolved

You are now ready to start editing with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}. Double-clicking on a C# script in Unity will open {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}. Here is a list of some of the things you can expect:

* Syntax Highlighting
* Bracket matching
* IntelliSense
* Snippets
* CodeLens
* Peek
* Go-to Definition
* Code Actions/Lightbulbs
* Go to symbol
* Hover

Two topics that will help you are [Basic Editing](/docs/editing/codebasics.md) and [C#](/docs/languages/csharp.md). In the image below, you can see {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} showing hover context, peeking references, and more.

![editing evolved example](images/unity/peekreferences.png)
